notes: The smallest tide: two bars in 4/4, a breath in (third, fourth, fifth, held) and a breath out (down by step to the home note). Hymn-like; it says the most when it is said slowly. Spring: D major, bright piano; the bed comes in for the answer, a flute echoes the held note, harp touches the cadences.
